title_content_relation: Title premise is consistent with the directly reviewed visual structure and item demonstrations.
content_summary: Fast multi-item utility-list short. Physical oddness and close-up demonstrations function as the hook; each item is understood through direct use rather than static packshots.
reusable_editing_rules: Open on an unfamiliar action at macro scale before explaining it.
Use sub-second cuts heavily in the first 5 s, then allow 1–5 s demo holds for comprehension.
Alternate package proof with body/hand use shots.
confidence_notes: Direct visual review completed from first-frame, first-5-second 5fps, whole-video 1fps and scene-change contact sheets.
Audio spectrogram and metrics were visually/numerically inspected only; no direct listening claim is made.
Detected cut times support, but do not replace, the contact-sheet review.
Exact font family and direct sound characteristics are not fabricated.
